tasks.title: Prototype: server-authoritative collectible pickup + leaderstats
acceptance_criteria: Each player gets leaderstats.Coins = 0 on join
Server spawns N collectibles from shared config in a Workspace folder
Touch by a character awards CoinValue once, server-side, and the coin respawns after RespawnSeconds
Touches from non-characters, dead humanoids, or distances greater than MaxPickupDistance are ignored
Pure award/validation logic lives in src/shared and has passing tests in tests/luau
